                    <div class="mini-table-layout">
                        <div class="mini-table-center">🀄</div>

                    ${deckInfo}
                `;

                // 点击整个卡片也可以加入（如果未满且未开始）
                if (!isFull && !isPlaying) {
                    card.onclick = () => joinTableById(table.id);
                }

                container.appendChild(card);
            });

        // 发牌动画
        function showDealAnimation() {
            const dealAnimation = document.getElementById('dealAnimation');
            const dealPiles = document.getElementById('dealPiles');
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            dealAnimation.classList.remove('hidden');
            dealPiles.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建四堆牌（每堆17张，两层）
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const pile = document.createElement('div');
                pile.className = 'deal-pile';
                pile.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="deal-pile-label">${i + 1}号位</div>
                    <div class="deal-pile-cards" id="pile${i}"></div>
                `;
                dealPiles.appendChild(pile);
            }

            // 动画展示牌堆
            dealInfo.textContent = '展示牌堆...';
            let cardIndex = 0;
            const totalCards = 68; // 4人 × 17张

            const addCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (cardIndex >= totalCards) {
                    clearInterval(addCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌中...';
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    startDealing();
                    return;
                }

                const pileIndex = cardIndex % 4;
                const pile = document.getElementById(`pile${pileIndex}`);
                if (pile) {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'deal-card-back';
                    pile.appendChild(card);
                }

                cardIndex++;
                dealProgress.textContent = `${cardIndex} / ${totalCards}`;
            }, 30);
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function startDealing() {
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            let round = 0;
            let player = 0;
            let cardInRound = 0;
            const totalRounds = 4; // 4轮发牌

            const dealCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (round >= totalRounds) {
                    clearInterval(dealCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌完成！';
                    // 隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏界面
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                    }, 500);
                    return;
                }

                // 从牌堆移除一张牌
                const piles = document.querySelectorAll('.deal-pile-cards');
                for (let p of piles) {
                    if (p.lastChild) {
                        p.removeChild(p.lastChild);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cardInRound++;
                if (cardInRound >= 4) {
                    cardInRound = 0;
                    round++;
                }

                dealProgress.textContent = `第 ${round + 1} 轮`;
            }, 100);
        }

        // 更新游戏UI
        function updateGameUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;

            // 游戏开始后隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏操作按钮
            if (gameState.started) {
                document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                // 显示游戏操作按钮，隐藏准备/离开按钮
                document.getElementById('readyBtn').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('leaveBtn').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('playBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('faBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('gangBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('huBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
            }

            // 更新万能牌
            if (gameState.wildCard) {
                document.getElementById('wildCardDisplay').textContent =
                    getCardDisplayName(gameState.wildCard);
            }

            // 更新牌堆数量
            document.getElementById('deckCount').textContent = gameState.deckCount;

            // 更新游戏时间
            if (gameState.totalGameTime !== undefined) {
                const minutes = Math.floor(gameState.totalGameTime / 60);
                const seconds = gameState.totalGameTime % 60;
                const timeEl = document.getElementById('beijingTime');
                if (timeEl) {
                    timeEl.textContent =
                        `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
                }
            }

            // 更新各玩家信息
            // 先找到自己的座位号
            let mySeatNum = 1;
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (pid === Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo)[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = info.seatNum;
                    break;
                }
            }

            console.log('我的座位号:', mySeatNum);

            // 根据座位号计算显示位置
            // 麻将是逆时针：南(1)→西(2)→北(3)→东(4)
            // 屏幕布局：bottom=自己, left=西, top=北, right=东
            // position: 0=bottom(自己), 1=right(东), 2=top(北), 3=left(西)
            for (let seatNum = 1; seatNum <= 4; seatNum++) {
                // 逆时针计算相对位置
                // 从mySeatNum开始，逆时针数到seatNum
                let relativePos = (mySeatNum - seatNum + 4) % 4;

                // 映射到UI位置: 0->1(bottom), 1->2(right东), 2->3(top), 3->4(left西)
                const posNames = ['player1', 'player2', 'player3', 'player4'];
                const posName = posNames[relativePos];

                console.log(`座位${seatNum} -> 相对位置${relativePos} -> UI元素${posName}`);

                // 找到这个座位的玩家
                let foundPlayer = null;
                for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                    if (info.seatNum === seatNum) {
                        foundPlayer = info;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                const nameEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Name`);
                const countEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Count`);
                const infoEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Info`);
                const showedEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Showed`);

                if (!nameEl || !countEl || !infoEl || !showedEl) {
                    console.error('找不到元素:', posName);
                    continue;
                }

                if (foundPlayer) {
                    nameEl.textContent = foundPlayer.name;
                    countEl.textContent = foundPlayer.handCount;

                    // 高亮当前玩家
                    if (gameState.currentPlayerSeat === seatNum) {
                        infoEl.classList.add('active');
                        nameEl.classList.add('current-turn');
                    } else {
                        infoEl.classList.remove('active');
                        nameEl.classList.remove('current-turn');
                    }

                    // 展示区
                    showedEl.innerHTML = '';

                    if (foundPlayer.showedCards) {
                        foundPlayer.showedCards.fa.forEach(card => {
                            const div = document.createElement('div');
                            div.className = 'showed-card fa';
                            const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                            if (imgPath) {
                                div.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="發" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;">`;
                            } else {
                                div.textContent = '發';
                            }
                            showedEl.appendChild(div);
                        });

                        foundPlayer.showedCards.gang.forEach(gang => {
                            gang.forEach(card => {
                                const div = document.createElement('div');
                                div.className = 'showed-card gang';
                                const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                                if (imgPath) {
                                    div.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="${getCardShortName(card)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;">`;
                                } else {
                                    div.textContent = getCardShortName(card);
                                }
                                showedEl.appendChild(div);
                            });
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            // 更新牌墙状态
            console.log('收到 wallState:', gameState.wallState, '类型:', typeof gameState.wallState);
            if (gameState.wallState) {
                wallState = gameState.wallState;
                console.log('更新后全局 wallState:', wallState);
                // 重新渲染牌墙（保留亮牌信息）
                if (currentShownInfo) {
                    renderWall(currentShownInfo);
                } else {
                    renderWall();
                }
            }

            // 更新自己的手牌
            renderMyHand();

            // 更新按钮状态
            const isMyTurn = gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;
            document.getElementById('faBtn').disabled = !gameState.canChangeFa;
            document.getElementById('gangBtn').disabled = !gameState.canGang;

            // 更新回合提示
            updateTurnIndicator();
        }

        // 更新回合提示
        function updateTurnIndicator() {
            const turnIndicator = document.getElementById('turnIndicator');

            if (!gameState || !gameState.started) {
                turnIndicator.textContent = '等待开始...';

                if (info.seatNum === gameState.currentPlayerSeat) {

        // 获取牌对应的精灵图CSS类名
        function getTileSpriteClass(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                if (card.suit === '筒') {
                    return `tong${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '条') {
                    return `tiao${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '万') {
                    return `wan${card.rank}`;
                }
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                const windMap = { '东': 'feng_dong', '南': 'feng_nan', '西': 'feng_xi', '北': 'feng_bei' };
                return windMap[card.rank] || '';
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowMap = { '中': 'jian_zhong', '发': 'jian_fa', '白': 'jian_bai' };
                return arrowMap[card.rank] || '';
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌对应的图片路径
        function getTileImagePath(card) {
            const baseName = getTileSpriteClass(card);
            if (baseName) {
                return `Images/${baseName}.png`;
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getTileName(card) {
            if (!card) return '请选择一张牌';
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return `${card.rank}风`;
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowNames = { '中': '红中', '发': '发财', '白': '白板' };
                return arrowNames[card.rank] || card.rank;
            }
            return '未知牌';
        }

        // 更新手牌提示区
        function updateHandHint(card) {
            const hintCard = document.getElementById('handHintCard');
            const hintText = document.getElementById('handHintText');
            const hintArea = document.getElementById('handHint');

            if (!card) {
                // 没有选中牌时隐藏提示区域
                hintArea.style.display = 'none';
                hintCard.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            // 有选中牌时显示
            hintArea.style.display = 'flex';

            hintCard.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="${getTileName(card)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;">`;
            hintCard.className = 'hand-hint-card';

            hintText.textContent = getTileName(card);
        }

        // 渲染自己的手牌
        function renderMyHand() {
            const container = document.getElementById('myHand');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            console.log('renderMyHand 被调用, gameState:', gameState ? '存在' : '不存在');
            console.log('myHand:', gameState?.myHand);

            if (!gameState || !gameState.myHand) {
                console.log('没有手牌数据，返回');
                return;
            }

            console.log('开始渲染手牌，数量:', gameState.myHand.length);

            gameState.myHand.forEach(card => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'tile-img';

                // 获取图片路径
                const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                if (imgPath) {
                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                    img.src = imgPath;
                    img.alt = getTileName(card);
                    img.draggable = false;
                    div.appendChild(img);
                }

                // 判断是否是万能牌
                const isWild = isWildCard(card);
                if (isWild) {
                    div.classList.add('wild');
                }

                // 选中状态
                if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                    div.classList.add('selected');
                }

                div.onclick = () => selectCard(card);
                div.dataset.cardId = card.id;

                // 拖拽功能
                div.draggable = true;
                div.addEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
                div.addEventListener('dragend', handleDragEnd);
                div.addEventListener('dragover', handleDragOver);
                div.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop);
                div.addEventListener('dragleave', handleDragLeave);

                container.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        // 创建条子竹节
        function createBamboo(count) {
            let bamboo = '';
            if (count === 1) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-stick"></div>';
            } else if (count === 2) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 3) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div><div class="bamboo-row"><div class="bamboo-stick"></div><div class="bamboo-stick"></div></div>';
            } else if (count === 4) {

                // 发送骰子结果给服务器
                if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {

                        type: 'diceRoll',
                        values: diceValues
                    }));

            dice1.classList.add('rolling');
            dice2.classList.add('rolling');

            let count = 0;
            const interval = setInterval(() => {
                dice1.textContent = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
                dice2.textContent = Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;

        // ==================== 牌墙渲染 ====================
        // 牌墙状态：每方位17墩，每墩2张
        let wallState = {
            1: 17, // 东（1号位）
            2: 17, // 南（2号位）- 实际是右侧
            3: 17, // 西（3号位）- 上方

        // 保存亮牌信息
        let currentShownCard = null;

        // 渲染牌墙
        function renderWall(shownInfo = null) {
            const directions = ['North', 'South', 'West', 'East'];

            // 获取当前玩家的座位号
            let mySeatNum = 1;
            if (typeof gameState !== 'undefined' && gameState.playerInfo) {
                // 直接使用 myIndex 和 playerInfo 数组来获取自己的座位
                const playerIds = Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo);
                if (playerIds[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = gameState.playerInfo[playerIds[myIndex]].seatNum;
                }
            }

            // 根据玩家视角计算各方位对应的座位号
            // South(下) = 自己, North(上) = 对家, West(左) = 上家, East(右) = 下家
            const seatMap = {
                'South': mySeatNum,                    // 下 = 自己
                'North': (mySeatNum + 1) % 4 + 1,      // 上 = 对家
                'West': mySeatNum % 4 + 1,             // 左 = 上家（逆时针）
                'East': (mySeatNum + 2) % 4 + 1        // 右 = 下家（顺时针）
            };

            console.log(`牌墙渲染 - 我的座位: ${mySeatNum}, seatMap:`, seatMap, 'wallState:', wallState);

            directions.forEach(dir => {
                const wallEl = document.getElementById('wall' + dir);
                if (!wallEl) return;

                const seatNum = seatMap[dir];
                // 注意：wallState的键可能是字符串或数字，用两种方式尝试
                // 新格式：wallState[seatNum] = { start: 起始序号, count: 保留数量 }
                const state = wallState[seatNum] !== undefined ? wallState[seatNum] :
                              (wallState[String(seatNum)] !== undefined ? wallState[String(seatNum)] : { start: 1, count: 17 });

                // 兼容旧格式（纯数字）
                const keepStart = state.start !== undefined ? state.start : 1;
                const keepCount = state.count !== undefined ? state.count : (typeof state === 'number' ? state : 17);

                console.log(`牌墙 ${dir} -> 座位${seatNum} -> 保留序号${keepStart}开始的${keepCount}墩`);

                wallEl.innerHTML = '';

                // 牌墙序号方向（与抓牌方向一致）：
                // - 南（下）：左1→右17（序号递增）
                // - 西（左）：上1→下17（序号递增）
                // - 北（上）：左17→右1（序号递减）
                // - 东（右）：上17→下1（序号递减）
                // 抓牌顺序：南(1→17) → 西(1→17) → 北(17→1) → 东(17→1)
                // 保留的牌墩从 keepStart 开始，连续 keepCount 个

                for (let i = 0; i < 17; i++) {
                    const pile = document.createElement('div');
                    pile.className = 'wall-pile';

                    // 计算牌墩编号（1-17），根据方位确定
                    let pileNum;
                    if (dir === 'South') {
                        pileNum = i + 1;   // 左边是1，右边是17
                    } else if (dir === 'West') {
                        pileNum = i + 1;   // 上边是1，下边是17（i从上到下）
                    } else if (dir === 'North') {
                        pileNum = 17 - i;  // 左边是17，右边是1
                    } else { // East
                        pileNum = 17 - i;  // 上边是17，下边是1（i从上到下）
                    }

                    // 判断这个牌墩是否应该显示
                    // keepCount = 0 表示全部被抓
                    let showTile = false;
                    if (keepCount > 0) {
                        // 保留的是从 keepStart 开始的 keepCount 个牌墩（按抓牌方向）
                        // 抓牌方向：南/西序号递增，北/东序号递减
                        if (dir === 'South' || dir === 'West') {
                            // 序号递增方向：保留 keepStart 到 keepStart+keepCount-1
                            showTile = pileNum >= keepStart && pileNum < keepStart + keepCount;
                        } else {
                            // 序号递减方向：保留 keepStart 到 keepStart-keepCount+1
                            showTile = pileNum <= keepStart && pileNum > keepStart - keepCount;
                        }
                    }

                    if (showTile) {
                        // 创建两层的牌 - 上层和下层
                        const tile1 = document.createElement('div');
                        tile1.className = 'wall-tile top-tile';
                        const tile2 = document.createElement('div');
                        tile2.className = 'wall-tile bottom-tile';

                        // 添加牌墩序号标签（调试用）
                        const label = document.createElement('span');
                        label.className = 'pile-label';
                        label.textContent = pileNum;
                        label.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:10px;color:#666;z-index:10;background:rgba(255,255,255,0.7);border-radius:3px;padding:1px 3px;';
                        tile1.appendChild(label);

                        // 检查是否是亮牌位置
                        if (shownInfo && shownInfo.direction === seatNum && shownInfo.pile === pileNum) {
                            tile1.classList.add('shown');
                            // 在亮牌位置显示麻将牌图片
                            if (currentShownCard) {
                                const imgSrc = getCardImageSrc(currentShownCard);
                                if (imgSrc) {
                                    // 创建图片元素显示在牌墙上
                                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                                    img.src = imgSrc;

                                    // 根据方位调整图片旋转
                                    let rotation = 0;
                                    if (dir === 'North') {
                                        rotation = 0;
                                    } else if (dir === 'South') {
                                        rotation = 180;
                                    } else if (dir === 'West') {
                                        rotation = -90;
                                    } else if (dir === 'East') {
                                        rotation = 90;
                                    }

                                    img.style.cssText = `width:80%;height:80%;object-fit:contain;border-radius:2px;transform:rotate(${rotation}deg);position:absolute;top:10%;left:10%;`;
                                    tile1.innerHTML = '';
                                    tile1.appendChild(img);
                                }
                            }
                        }

                        pile.appendChild(tile1);
                        pile.appendChild(tile2);
                    } else {
                        // 已被抓走的牌墩 - 显示为空白的两层牌墙，并显示序号
                        const tile1 = document.createElement('div');
                        tile1.className = 'wall-tile top-tile empty';
                        const tile2 = document.createElement('div');
                        tile2.className = 'wall-tile bottom-tile empty';

                        // 空牌墩也显示序号（调试用）
                        const label = document.createElement('span');
                        label.className = 'pile-label';
                        label.textContent = pileNum;
                        label.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:50%;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-50%);font-size:10px;color:#999;z-index:10;';
                        tile1.appendChild(label);

                        pile.appendChild(tile1);
                        pile.appendChild(tile2);
                    }

                    wallEl.appendChild(pile);
                }
            });
        }

        /* 布局: 一条(0), 二条(1), ..., 九条(8) */
        .tile-sprite.tiao1 { background-position: calc((-0 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao2 { background-position: calc((-1 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao3 { background-position: calc((-2 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 万子位置 (第2行: row 2) - 1-9万在列0-8 */

        .tile-sprite.wan1 { background-position: calc((-0 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan2 { background-position: calc((-1 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 麻将牌基础样式 - 图片中的真实样式 */
        .card {

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */

        /* 牌面内容容器 */

        /* 筒子牌 - 圆点图案 */
        .card.tong .card-face {
            position: relative;

        .card.tong .dot-container {
            width: 24px;
            height: 32px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
        }

        .card.tong .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #90caf9, #1976d2 70%, #0d47a1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 1筒 - 大圆带花边 */
        .card.tong.p1 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.tong.p1 .dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #64b5f6, #1976d2 60%, #0d47a1);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
                0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 2筒 */
        .card.tong.p2 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        /* 3筒 */
        .card.tong.p3 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 2; justify-self: center; }

        /* 4筒 */
        .card.tong.p4 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px;
        }

        /* 5筒 */
        .card.tong.p5 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }

        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }

        .card.tong.p6 .dot-container {

            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;

        .card.tong.p7 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(6) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(7) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 8px; height: 8px; }

        /* 8筒 */
        .card.tong.p8 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;

        .card.tong.p8 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; display: none; }
        .card.tong.p8 .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; }

        /* 9筒 */
        .card.tong.p9 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);

        /* ==================== 牌墙样式 ==================== */
        .wall-container {
            position: absolute;
            top: 50%;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translate(-50%, -50%);
            width: 700px;
            height: 600px;
            pointer-events: none;
            z-index: 0;
            display: none; /* 默认隐藏 */
        }

        .wall-section {
            position: absolute;
            display: flex;
        }

        /* 上方牌墙（北-3号位）- 水平排列，居中 */
        .wall-top {
            top: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            flex-direction: row;
            gap: 1px;
        }

        /* 下方牌墙（南-1号位）- 水平排列，居中 */
        .wall-bottom {
            bottom: 10px;
            left: 50%;
            transform: translateX(-50%);
            flex-direction: row;
            gap: 1px;
        }

        /* 左方牌墙（西-4号位）- 垂直排列，居中 */
        .wall-left {
            left: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1px;
        }

        /* 右方牌墙（东-2号位）- 垂直排列，居中 */
        .wall-right {
            right: 10px;
            top: 50%;
            transform: translateY(-50%);
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 1px;
        }

        /* 牌墩容器 - 每墩两张牌叠放 */
        .wall-pile {
            position: relative;
        }

        /* 上下牌墩尺寸 - 包含侧边厚度 */
        .wall-top .wall-pile,
        .wall-bottom .wall-pile {
            width: 28px;
            height: 50px;
        }

        /* 左右牌墩尺寸 - 包含侧边厚度 */
        .wall-left .wall-pile,
        .wall-right .wall-pile {
            width: 50px;
            height: 28px;
        }

        /* 牌墩中的单张牌 - 带侧边的3D效果 */
        .wall-tile {
            position: absolute;
            border-radius: 3px 3px 2px 2px;
        }

        /* ============ 3D牌面效果 ============ */
        /* 上面的牌（顶层）- 带侧边 */
        .wall-tile.top-tile {
            z-index: 2;
        }

        /* 上面的牌的侧边（使用伪元素） */
        .wall-tile.top-tile::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            background: #1B5E20;
            border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px;
        }

        /* 下面的牌（底层）- 带侧边 */
        .wall-tile.bottom-tile {
            z-index: 1;
        }

        /* 下面的牌的侧边 */
        .wall-tile.bottom-tile::after {
            content: '';
            position: absolute;
            background: #0D3D0D;
            border-radius: 0 0 2px 2px;
        }

        /* ============ 上下牌墙：上下堆叠，侧边朝下 ============ */
        .wall-top .wall-tile,
        .wall-bottom .wall-tile {
            width: 28px;
            height: 40px;
        }

        /* 上面的牌（顶层）- 更亮 */
        .wall-top .wall-tile.top-tile,
        .wall-bottom .wall-tile.top-tile {
            top: 0;
            left: 0;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #b8f0b8 0%, #81C784 40%, #4CAF50 100%);
            border: 1px solid #2E7D32;
            box-shadow: 2px 2px 4px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
        }

        /* 上面的牌的侧边 */
        .wall-top .wall-tile.top-tile::after,
        .wall-bottom .wall-tile.top-tile::after {
            left: 1px;
            bottom: -6px;
            width: 26px;
            height: 6px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #2E7D32, #1B5E20);

        /* 下面的牌（底层）- 更暗 */

<body>
    <!-- 登录/大厅界面 -->
    <div id="loginScreen">

    <script>
        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
                // 连接后立即获取牌桌列表
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 保存用户名到 localStorage
                    localStorage.setItem('majiangPlayerName', playerName);
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    showGame();  // 确保显示游戏界面
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'diceState':
                    // 骰子状态更新
                    handleDiceState(data.data);
                    break;

                case 'roundEnd':
                    // 一局结束，显示结果并等待准备
                    handleRoundEnd(data.data);
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);
            } else {
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
            }

        // 发牌动画
        function showDealAnimation() {
            const dealAnimation = document.getElementById('dealAnimation');
            const dealPiles = document.getElementById('dealPiles');
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            dealAnimation.classList.remove('hidden');
            dealPiles.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建四堆牌（每堆17张，两层）
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const pile = document.createElement('div');
                pile.className = 'deal-pile';
                pile.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="deal-pile-label">${i + 1}号位</div>
                    <div class="deal-pile-cards" id="pile${i}"></div>
                `;
                dealPiles.appendChild(pile);
            }

            // 动画展示牌堆
            dealInfo.textContent = '展示牌堆...';
            let cardIndex = 0;
            const totalCards = 68; // 4人 × 17张

            const addCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (cardIndex >= totalCards) {
                    clearInterval(addCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌中...';
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    startDealing();
                    return;
                }

                const pileIndex = cardIndex % 4;
                const pile = document.getElementById(`pile${pileIndex}`);
                if (pile) {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'deal-card-back';
                    pile.appendChild(card);
                }

                cardIndex++;
                dealProgress.textContent = `${cardIndex} / ${totalCards}`;
            }, 30);
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function startDealing() {
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            let round = 0;
            let player = 0;
            let cardInRound = 0;
            const totalRounds = 4; // 4轮发牌

            const dealCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (round >= totalRounds) {
                    clearInterval(dealCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌完成！';
                    // 隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏界面
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                    }, 500);
                    return;
                }

                // 从牌堆移除一张牌
                const piles = document.querySelectorAll('.deal-pile-cards');
                for (let p of piles) {
                    if (p.lastChild) {
                        p.removeChild(p.lastChild);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cardInRound++;
                if (cardInRound >= 4) {
                    cardInRound = 0;
                    round++;
                }

                dealProgress.textContent = `第 ${round + 1} 轮`;
            }, 100);
        }

            // 更新各玩家信息

            let mySeatNum = 1;
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (pid === Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo)[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = info.seatNum;
                    break;
                }
            }

            console.log('我的座位号:', mySeatNum);

            // 根据座位号计算显示位置
            // 麻将是逆时针：南(1)→西(2)→北(3)→东(4)
            // 屏幕布局：bottom=自己, left=西, top=北, right=东
            // position: 0=bottom(自己), 1=right(东), 2=top(北), 3=left(西)
            for (let seatNum = 1; seatNum <= 4; seatNum++) {
                // 逆时针计算相对位置
                // 从mySeatNum开始，逆时针数到seatNum
                let relativePos = (mySeatNum - seatNum + 4) % 4;

                // 映射到UI位置: 0->1(bottom), 1->2(right东), 2->3(top), 3->4(left西)
                const posNames = ['player1', 'player2', 'player3', 'player4'];
                const posName = posNames[relativePos];

                console.log(`座位${seatNum} -> 相对位置${relativePos} -> UI元素${posName}`);

                // 找到这个座位的玩家
                let foundPlayer = null;
                for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {

                const countEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Count`);

                const showedEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Showed`);

                if (!nameEl || !countEl || !infoEl || !showedEl) {
                    console.error('找不到元素:', posName);
                    continue;

                if (foundPlayer) {
                    nameEl.textContent = foundPlayer.name;
                    countEl.textContent = foundPlayer.handCount;

                    // 高亮当前玩家
                    if (gameState.currentPlayerSeat === seatNum) {
                        infoEl.classList.add('active');
                        nameEl.classList.add('current-turn');
                    } else {
                        infoEl.classList.remove('active');
                        nameEl.classList.remove('current-turn');
                    }

                    // 展示区
                    showedEl.innerHTML = '';

                    if (foundPlayer.showedCards) {
                        foundPlayer.showedCards.fa.forEach(card => {
                            const div = document.createElement('div');
                            div.className = 'showed-card fa';
                            const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                            if (imgPath) {

                            } else {

        // 获取牌对应的精灵图CSS类名
        function getTileSpriteClass(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                if (card.suit === '筒') {
                    return `tong${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '条') {
                    return `tiao${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '万') {
                    return `wan${card.rank}`;
                }
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                const windMap = { '东': 'feng_dong', '南': 'feng_nan', '西': 'feng_xi', '北': 'feng_bei' };
                return windMap[card.rank] || '';
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowMap = { '中': 'jian_zhong', '发': 'jian_fa', '白': 'jian_bai' };
                return arrowMap[card.rank] || '';
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌对应的图片路径
        function getTileImagePath(card) {
            const baseName = getTileSpriteClass(card);
            if (baseName) {
                return `Images/${baseName}.png`;
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getTileName(card) {
            if (!card) return '请选择一张牌';
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return `${card.rank}风`;
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowNames = { '中': '红中', '发': '发财', '白': '白板' };
                return arrowNames[card.rank] || card.rank;
            }
            return '未知牌';
        }

        // 拖拽相关变量
        let draggedCardId = null;

        function handleDragStart(e) {
            draggedCardId = e.target.dataset.cardId;
            e.target.classList.add('dragging');
            e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = 'move';
        }

        function handleDragEnd(e) {
            e.target.classList.remove('dragging');
            document.querySelectorAll('.card').forEach(card => {
                card.classList.remove('drag-over');
            });
            draggedCardId = null;
        }

        function handleDragOver(e) {
            e.preventDefault();
            e.dataTransfer.dropEffect = 'move';
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target && target.dataset.cardId !== draggedCardId) {
                target.classList.add('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDragLeave(e) {
            const target = e.target.closest('.card');
            if (target) {
                target.classList.remove('drag-over');
            }
        }

        function handleDrop(e) {
            e.preventDefault();

        // 掷骰子

            if (typeof gameState !== 'undefined' && gameState.playerInfo) {
                // 直接使用 myIndex 和 playerInfo 数组来获取自己的座位

                if (playerIds[myIndex]) {

            // 根据玩家视角计算各方位对应的座位号
            // 麻将逆时针：南(1) → 西(2) → 北(3) → 东(4) → 南(1)
            // 从自己开始，上家是逆时针上一个，下家是逆时针下一个
            // South(下) = 自己, North(上) = 对家, West(左) = 上家, East(右) = 下家
            const seatMap = {

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */
        .tile-sprite.wild {
            border: 2px solid #ffa000;
            box-shadow:
                0 2px 6px rgba(255,152,0,0.5),
                0 4px 10px rgba(255,152,0,0.3),
                0 0 12px rgba(255,160,0,0.6);
        }

        /* 癞子标记 */
        .tile-sprite.wild::before {
            content: '癞';
            position: absolute;
            top: -2px;
            right: -2px;
            width: 14px;
            height: 14px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5722 0%, #e64a19 100%);
            color: white;
            font-size: 9px;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 0 3px 0 4px;
            box-shadow: -1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 5;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        /* 筒子位置 (第0行: row 0) - 红中在列0，1-9筒在列1-9 */
        /* 布局: 红中(0), 一筒(1), 二筒(2), ..., 九筒(9) */
        .tile-sprite.tong1 { background-position: calc((-1 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong2 { background-position: calc((-2 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong3 { background-position: calc((-3 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong4 { background-position: calc((-4 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong5 { background-position: calc((-5 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong6 { background-position: calc((-6 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong7 { background-position: calc((-7 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong8 { background-position: calc((-8 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tong9 { background-position: calc((-9 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-0 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 条子位置 (第1行: row 1) - 1-9条在列0-8 */
        /* 布局: 一条(0), 二条(1), ..., 九条(8) */
        .tile-sprite.tiao1 { background-position: calc((-0 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao2 { background-position: calc((-1 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao3 { background-position: calc((-2 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao4 { background-position: calc((-3 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao5 { background-position: calc((-4 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao6 { background-position: calc((-5 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao7 { background-position: calc((-6 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao8 { background-position: calc((-7 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.tiao9 { background-position: calc((-8 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-1 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 万子位置 (第2行: row 2) - 1-9万在列0-8 */
        /* 布局: 一万(0), 二万(1), ..., 九万(8) */
        .tile-sprite.wan1 { background-position: calc((-0 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan2 { background-position: calc((-1 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan3 { background-position: calc((-2 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan4 { background-position: calc((-3 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan5 { background-position: calc((-4 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan6 { background-position: calc((-5 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan7 { background-position: calc((-6 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan8 { background-position: calc((-7 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.wan9 { background-position: calc((-8 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 风牌位置 */
        /* 布局: 東在第2行列9, 南(3,0), 西(3,1), 北(3,2) */
        .tile-sprite.feng_dong { background-position: calc((-9 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-2 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.feng_nan { background-position: calc((-0 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.feng_xi { background-position: calc((-1 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.feng_bei { background-position: calc((-2 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 箭牌位置 (第3行: row 3, 续) */
        /* 布局: 中(3,3), 發(3,4), 白(3,5) */
        .tile-sprite.jian_zhong { background-position: calc((-3 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.jian_fa { background-position: calc((-4 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }
        .tile-sprite.jian_bai { background-position: calc((-5 * 61.7px + 2px) * 0.65) calc((-3 * 93.25px + 4px) * 0.65); }

        /* 麻将牌基础样式 - 图片中的真实样式 */
        .card {
            width: 34px;
            height: 48px;
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #f5f5f0 0%, #e8e8e0 50%, #ddd8d0 100%);
            border-radius: 3px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            cursor: pointer;
            transition: all 0.1s ease;
            position: relative;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 2px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 3px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 4px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 5px 3px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            border: 1px solid #d8d0c8;
        }

        .card:hover {
            transform: translateY(-5px);

                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 3px 0 #d0c8c0,

                0 7px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 9px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.35);

        }

        .card.selected {
            transform: translateY(-12px);
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #c8c0b8,
                0 4px 0 #d0c8c0,
                0 7px 0 #c0b8b0,
                0 10px 0 #b0a8a0,
                0 13px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.4);
            z-index: 20;
        }

        .card.dragging {
            opacity: 0.6;
            transform: scale(1.1);
        }

        .card.drag-over {
            border-left: 3px solid #FFD700;
        }

        /* 万能牌样式 - 癞子 */
        .card.wild {
            background: linear-gradient(180deg, #fff8e1 0%, #ffecb3 50%, #ffe082 100%);
            border: 2px solid #ffa000;
            box-shadow:
                1px 0 0 #ff8f00,
                0 2px 0 #f57c00,
                0 3px 0 #ef6c00,
                0 4px 0 #e65100,
                0 5px 3px rgba(255,152,0,0.4),
                0 0 10px rgba(255,160,0,0.5);
        }

        /* 癞子标记 */
        .card.wild::before {
            content: '癞';
            position: absolute;
            top: -2px;
            right: -2px;
            width: 13px;
            height: 13px;
            background: linear-gradient(135deg, #ff5722 0%, #e64a19 100%);
            color: white;
            font-size: 8px;
            font-weight: bold;
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            border-radius: 0 3px 0 4px;
            box-shadow: -1px 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
            z-index: 5;
            line-height: 1;
        }

        /* 牌面内容容器 */
        .card-face {
            width: 28px;
            height: 40px;
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
            background: #fafaf5;
            border-radius: 2px;
            box-shadow: inset 0 0 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
            border: 1px solid #e8e0d8;
        }

        /* 筒子牌 - 圆点图案 */
        .card.tong .card-face {
            position: relative;
        }

        .card.tong .dot-container {
            width: 24px;
            height: 32px;
            display: grid;
            place-items: center;
        }

        .card.tong .dot {
            width: 6px;
            height: 6px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #90caf9, #1976d2 70%, #0d47a1);
            border-radius: 50%;
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 2px rgba(255,255,255,0.5),
                0 1px 1px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 1筒 - 大圆带花边 */
        .card.tong.p1 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            align-items: center;
            justify-content: center;
        }
        .card.tong.p1 .dot {
            width: 12px;
            height: 12px;
            background: radial-gradient(circle at 40% 40%, #64b5f6, #1976d2 60%, #0d47a1);
            box-shadow:
                inset 0 1px 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.6),
                inset 0 -1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.2),
                0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.15);
        }

        /* 2筒 */
        .card.tong.p2 .dot-container {
            display: flex;
            flex-direction: column;
            gap: 5px;
        }

        /* 3筒 */
        .card.tong.p3 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p3 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 1 / 3; grid-row: 2; justify-self: center; }

        /* 4筒 */
        .card.tong.p4 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(2, 1fr);
            gap: 4px;
            padding: 2px;
        }

        /* 5筒 */
        .card.tong.p5 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 8px; height: 8px; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p5 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }

        /* 6筒 */
        .card.tong.p6 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }

        /* 7筒 */
        .card.tong.p7 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(1) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(2) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 2; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(3) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 2; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(5) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(6) { grid-column: 3; grid-row: 3; }
        .card.tong.p7 .dot:nth-child(7) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; width: 8px; height: 8px; }

        /* 8筒 */
        .card.tong.p8 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 1px;
        }
        .card.tong.p8 .dot:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 2; display: none; }
        .card.tong.p8 .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; }

        /* 9筒 */
        .card.tong.p9 .dot-container {
            display: grid;
            grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
            grid-template-rows: repeat(3, 1fr);
            gap: 2px;
        }
        .card.tong.p9 .dot { width: 5px; height: 5px; }

<body>
    <!-- 登录/大厅界面 -->
    <div id="loginScreen">
        <h1>🀄 桐城自摸麻将 🀄</h1>

    <script>
        // 全局变量
        let ws = null;
        let playerId = null;
        let playerName = '';
        let currentTableId = null;
        let selectedCard = null;
        let gameState = null;
        let myIndex = 0;
        let isReady = false;

        // 连接WebSocket
        function connect() {
            const protocol = window.location.protocol === 'https:' ? 'wss:' : 'ws:';
            ws = new WebSocket(`${protocol}//${window.location.host}`);

            ws.onopen = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已连接');
                // 连接后立即获取牌桌列表
                ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
            };

            ws.onmessage = (event) => {
                const data = JSON.parse(event.data);
                handleMessage(data);
            };

            ws.onclose = () => {
                console.log('WebSocket已断开');
                setTimeout(() => {
                    if (playerId) {
                        connect();
                    }
                }, 3000);
            };

            ws.onerror = (error) => {
                console.error('WebSocket错误:', error);
            };
        }

        // 处理消息
        function handleMessage(data) {
            switch (data.type) {
                case 'loginSuccess':
                    playerId = data.playerId;
                    playerName = data.playerName;
                    // 保存用户名到 localStorage
                    localStorage.setItem('majiangPlayerName', playerName);
                    // 登录成功后获取牌桌列表
                    if (ws && ws.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'getTableList' }));
                    }
                    break;

                case 'tableList':
                    renderTableList(data.tables);
                    break;

                case 'playerList':
                    renderPlayerList(data);
                    break;

                case 'dealStart':
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    showDealAnimation();
                    break;

                case 'gameState':
                    gameState = data.data;
                    myIndex = gameState.myIndex;
                    console.log('收到游戏状态:', gameState);
                    console.log('我的手牌:', gameState.myHand);
                    console.log('手牌数量:', gameState.myHand ? gameState.myHand.length : 0);
                    showGame();  // 确保显示游戏界面
                    updateGameUI();
                    break;

                case 'diceState':
                    // 骰子状态更新
                    handleDiceState(data.data);
                    break;

                case 'roundEnd':
                    // 一局结束，显示结果并等待准备
                    handleRoundEnd(data.data);
                    break;

                case 'message':
                    addChatMessage(data.text);
                    break;

                case 'error':
                    alert(data.message);
                    break;
            }
        }

        // 确保已登录
        function ensureLogin(callback) {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请先输入名称');
                return false;
            }

            if (!playerId || !playerName) {
                playerName = name;
                if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                    connect();
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                        if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                    }, 500);
                } else {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                    if (callback) setTimeout(callback, 300);
                }
                return true;
            }
            return true;
        }

        // 登录
        function login() {
            const name = document.getElementById('playerName').value.trim();
            if (!name) {
                alert('请输入名字');
                return;
            }

            playerName = name;
            if (!ws || ws.readyState !== WebSocket.OPEN) {
                connect();
                setTimeout(() => {
                    ws.send(JSON.stringify({ type: 'login', name }));
                }, 500);

        // 渲染牌桌列表
        function renderTableList(tables) {
            const container = document.getElementById('tableList');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建新桌卡片
            const createCard = document.createElement('div');

                <div class="plus">+</div>
                <div class="text">开房</div>
            `;

                // 生成圆桌座位显示
                let seatsHtml = '';
                for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                    const seatNum = i + 1;
                    const player = table.players.find(p => p.seatNum === seatNum);
                    const occupied = !!player;
                    const occupiedClass = occupied ? 'occupied' : '';
                    const clickHandler = (!occupied && !isPlaying) ? `onclick="event.stopPropagation(); joinTableById('${table.id}', ${seatNum})"` : '';
                    const title = occupied && player ? player.name : (isPlaying ? '' : '点击加入');
                    const displayChar = occupied ? (player ? player.name.charAt(0) : '?') : '+';

                    seatsHtml += `
                        <div class="mini-seat mini-seat-${seatNum}">
                            <div class="mini-seat-avatar ${occupiedClass}" ${clickHandler} title="${title}">
                                ${displayChar}
                            </div>
                        </div>
                    `;
                }

                // 状态文字
                let statusText = `${table.playerCount}/4 人`;
                let statusClass = '';
                let deckInfo = '';
                if (isPlaying) {
                    const deckCount = table.deckCount !== undefined ? table.deckCount : '?';
                    deckInfo = `<div class="deck-info">剩余: ${deckCount}张</div>`;
                    statusText = '🀄 游戏中';
                    statusClass = 'playing';
                } else if (isFull) {
                    statusText = '已满员';
                    statusClass = 'full';
                }

                card.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="table-header">

                        <div class="table-mode-badge">${isPlaying ? '游戏中' : '等待中'}</div>
                    </div>
                    <div class="mini-table-layout">
                        <div class="mini-table-center">🀄</div>
                        ${seatsHtml}

                    <div class="table-footer ${statusClass}">${statusText}</div>
                    ${deckInfo}
                `;

                // 点击整个卡片也可以加入（如果未满且未开始）
                if (!isFull && !isPlaying) {
                    card.onclick = () => joinTableById(table.id);
                }

                container.appendChild(card);

        // 发牌动画
        function showDealAnimation() {
            const dealAnimation = document.getElementById('dealAnimation');
            const dealPiles = document.getElementById('dealPiles');
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            dealAnimation.classList.remove('hidden');
            dealPiles.innerHTML = '';

            // 创建四堆牌（每堆17张，两层）
            for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
                const pile = document.createElement('div');
                pile.className = 'deal-pile';
                pile.innerHTML = `
                    <div class="deal-pile-label">${i + 1}号位</div>
                    <div class="deal-pile-cards" id="pile${i}"></div>
                `;
                dealPiles.appendChild(pile);
            }

            // 动画展示牌堆
            dealInfo.textContent = '展示牌堆...';
            let cardIndex = 0;
            const totalCards = 68; // 4人 × 17张

            const addCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (cardIndex >= totalCards) {
                    clearInterval(addCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌中...';
                    // 开始发牌动画
                    startDealing();
                    return;
                }

                const pileIndex = cardIndex % 4;
                const pile = document.getElementById(`pile${pileIndex}`);
                if (pile) {
                    const card = document.createElement('div');
                    card.className = 'deal-card-back';
                    pile.appendChild(card);
                }

                cardIndex++;
                dealProgress.textContent = `${cardIndex} / ${totalCards}`;
            }, 30);
        }

        // 发牌动画
        function startDealing() {
            const dealInfo = document.getElementById('dealInfo');
            const dealProgress = document.getElementById('dealProgress');

            let round = 0;
            let player = 0;
            let cardInRound = 0;
            const totalRounds = 4; // 4轮发牌

            const dealCard = setInterval(() => {
                if (round >= totalRounds) {
                    clearInterval(dealCard);
                    dealInfo.textContent = '发牌完成！';
                    // 隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏界面
                    setTimeout(() => {
                        document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                    }, 500);
                    return;
                }

                // 从牌堆移除一张牌
                const piles = document.querySelectorAll('.deal-pile-cards');
                for (let p of piles) {
                    if (p.lastChild) {
                        p.removeChild(p.lastChild);
                        break;
                    }
                }

                cardInRound++;
                if (cardInRound >= 4) {
                    cardInRound = 0;
                    round++;
                }

                dealProgress.textContent = `第 ${round + 1} 轮`;
            }, 100);
        }

        // 更新游戏UI
        function updateGameUI() {
            if (!gameState) return;

            // 游戏开始后隐藏发牌动画，显示游戏操作按钮
            if (gameState.started) {
                document.getElementById('dealAnimation').classList.add('hidden');
                // 显示游戏操作按钮，隐藏准备/离开按钮
                document.getElementById('readyBtn').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('leaveBtn').style.display = 'none';
                document.getElementById('playBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('faBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('gangBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
                document.getElementById('huBtn').style.display = 'inline-block';
            }

            // 更新万能牌
            if (gameState.wildCard) {
                document.getElementById('wildCardDisplay').textContent =
                    getCardDisplayName(gameState.wildCard);
            }

            // 更新牌堆数量
            document.getElementById('deckCount').textContent = gameState.deckCount;

            // 更新游戏时间
            if (gameState.totalGameTime !== undefined) {
                const minutes = Math.floor(gameState.totalGameTime / 60);
                const seconds = gameState.totalGameTime % 60;
                const timeEl = document.getElementById('beijingTime');
                if (timeEl) {
                    timeEl.textContent =
                        `${minutes.toString().padStart(2, '0')}:${seconds.toString().padStart(2, '0')}`;
                }
            }

            // 更新各玩家信息
            // 先找到自己的座位号
            let mySeatNum = 1;
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (pid === Object.keys(gameState.playerInfo)[myIndex]) {
                    mySeatNum = info.seatNum;
                    break;
                }
            }

            console.log('我的座位号:', mySeatNum);

            // 根据座位号计算显示位置
            // 麻将是逆时针：南(1)→西(2)→北(3)→东(4)
            // 屏幕布局：bottom=自己, left=西, top=北, right=东
            // position: 0=bottom(自己), 1=right(东), 2=top(北), 3=left(西)
            for (let seatNum = 1; seatNum <= 4; seatNum++) {
                // 逆时针计算相对位置
                // 从mySeatNum开始，逆时针数到seatNum
                let relativePos = (mySeatNum - seatNum + 4) % 4;

                // 映射到UI位置: 0->1(bottom), 1->2(right东), 2->3(top), 3->4(left西)
                const posNames = ['player1', 'player2', 'player3', 'player4'];
                const posName = posNames[relativePos];

                console.log(`座位${seatNum} -> 相对位置${relativePos} -> UI元素${posName}`);

                // 找到这个座位的玩家
                let foundPlayer = null;
                for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                    if (info.seatNum === seatNum) {
                        foundPlayer = info;
                        break;
                    }
                }

                const nameEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Name`);
                const countEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Count`);
                const infoEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Info`);
                const showedEl = document.getElementById(`${posName}Showed`);

                if (!nameEl || !countEl || !infoEl || !showedEl) {
                    console.error('找不到元素:', posName);
                    continue;
                }

                if (foundPlayer) {
                    nameEl.textContent = foundPlayer.name;
                    countEl.textContent = foundPlayer.handCount;

                    // 高亮当前玩家
                    if (gameState.currentPlayerSeat === seatNum) {
                        infoEl.classList.add('active');
                        nameEl.classList.add('current-turn');
                    } else {
                        infoEl.classList.remove('active');
                        nameEl.classList.remove('current-turn');
                    }

                    // 展示区
                    showedEl.innerHTML = '';

                    if (foundPlayer.showedCards) {
                        foundPlayer.showedCards.fa.forEach(card => {
                            const div = document.createElement('div');
                            div.className = 'showed-card fa';
                            const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                            if (imgPath) {
                                div.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="發" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;">`;
                            } else {
                                div.textContent = '發';
                            }
                            showedEl.appendChild(div);
                        });

                        foundPlayer.showedCards.gang.forEach(gang => {
                            gang.forEach(card => {
                                const div = document.createElement('div');
                                div.className = 'showed-card gang';
                                const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                                if (imgPath) {
                                    div.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="${getCardShortName(card)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;">`;
                                } else {
                                    div.textContent = getCardShortName(card);
                                }
                                showedEl.appendChild(div);
                            });
                        });
                    }
                }
            }

            // 更新牌墙状态
            console.log('收到 wallState:', gameState.wallState, '类型:', typeof gameState.wallState);
            if (gameState.wallState) {
                wallState = gameState.wallState;
                console.log('更新后全局 wallState:', wallState);
                // 重新渲染牌墙（保留亮牌信息）
                if (currentShownInfo) {
                    renderWall(currentShownInfo);
                } else {
                    renderWall();
                }
            }

            // 更新自己的手牌
            renderMyHand();

            // 更新按钮状态
            const isMyTurn = gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;
            document.getElementById('playBtn').disabled = !isMyTurn || !selectedCard;
            document.getElementById('faBtn').disabled = !gameState.canChangeFa;
            document.getElementById('gangBtn').disabled = !gameState.canGang;

            // 更新回合提示
            updateTurnIndicator();
        }

        // 更新回合提示
        function updateTurnIndicator() {
            const turnIndicator = document.getElementById('turnIndicator');
            const handArea = document.getElementById('myHand');

            if (!gameState || !gameState.started) {
                turnIndicator.textContent = '等待开始...';
                turnIndicator.classList.remove('my-turn');
                handArea.classList.remove('my-turn');
                return;
            }

            // 找到当前玩家的名字
            let currentPlayerName = '';
            for (const [pid, info] of Object.entries(gameState.playerInfo)) {
                if (info.seatNum === gameState.currentPlayerSeat) {
                    currentPlayerName = info.name;
                    break;
                }

            const isMyTurn = gameState.currentPlayer === myIndex;

            if (isMyTurn) {
                turnIndicator.textContent = '🎯 轮到你出牌！';
                turnIndicator.classList.add('my-turn');
                handArea.classList.add('my-turn');

                turnIndicator.classList.remove('my-turn');
                handArea.classList.remove('my-turn');

        // 获取牌对应的精灵图CSS类名
        function getTileSpriteClass(card) {
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                if (card.suit === '筒') {
                    return `tong${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '条') {
                    return `tiao${card.rank}`;
                } else if (card.suit === '万') {
                    return `wan${card.rank}`;
                }
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                const windMap = { '东': 'feng_dong', '南': 'feng_nan', '西': 'feng_xi', '北': 'feng_bei' };
                return windMap[card.rank] || '';
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowMap = { '中': 'jian_zhong', '发': 'jian_fa', '白': 'jian_bai' };
                return arrowMap[card.rank] || '';
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌对应的图片路径
        function getTileImagePath(card) {
            const baseName = getTileSpriteClass(card);
            if (baseName) {
                return `Images/${baseName}.png`;
            }
            return '';
        }

        // 获取牌的显示名称
        function getTileName(card) {
            if (!card) return '请选择一张牌';
            if (card.type === 'number') {
                return `${card.rank}${card.suit}`;
            } else if (card.type === 'wind') {
                return `${card.rank}风`;
            } else if (card.type === 'arrow') {
                const arrowNames = { '中': '红中', '发': '发财', '白': '白板' };
                return arrowNames[card.rank] || card.rank;
            }
            return '未知牌';
        }

        // 更新手牌提示区
        function updateHandHint(card) {
            const hintCard = document.getElementById('handHintCard');
            const hintText = document.getElementById('handHintText');
            const hintArea = document.getElementById('handHint');

            if (!card) {
                // 没有选中牌时隐藏提示区域
                hintArea.style.display = 'none';
                hintCard.innerHTML = '';
                return;
            }

            // 有选中牌时显示
            hintArea.style.display = 'flex';
            const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
            hintCard.innerHTML = `<img src="${imgPath}" alt="${getTileName(card)}" style="width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;">`;
            hintCard.className = 'hand-hint-card';

            hintText.textContent = getTileName(card);
        }

        // 渲染自己的手牌
        function renderMyHand() {
            const container = document.getElementById('myHand');
            container.innerHTML = '';

            console.log('renderMyHand 被调用, gameState:', gameState ? '存在' : '不存在');
            console.log('myHand:', gameState?.myHand);

            if (!gameState || !gameState.myHand) {
                console.log('没有手牌数据，返回');
                return;
            }

            console.log('开始渲染手牌，数量:', gameState.myHand.length);

            gameState.myHand.forEach(card => {
                const div = document.createElement('div');
                div.className = 'tile-img';

                // 获取图片路径
                const imgPath = getTileImagePath(card);
                if (imgPath) {
                    const img = document.createElement('img');
                    img.src = imgPath;
                    img.alt = getTileName(card);
                    img.draggable = false;
                    div.appendChild(img);
                }

                // 判断是否是万能牌
                const isWild = isWildCard(card);
                if (isWild) {
                    div.classList.add('wild');
                }

                // 选中状态
                if (selectedCard && selectedCard.id === card.id) {
                    div.classList.add('selected');
                }

                div.onclick = () => selectCard(card);
                div.dataset.cardId = card.id;

                // 拖拽功能
                div.draggable = true;
                div.addEventListener('dragstart', handleDragStart);
                div.addEventListener('dragend', handleDragEnd);
                div.addEventListener('dragover', handleDragOver);
                div.addEventListener('drop', handleDrop);
                div.addEventListener('dragleave', handleDragLeave);

                container.appendChild(div);
            });
        }

        // 创建筒子圆点
        function createDots(count) {
            let dots = '';
            for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
                dots += '<div class="dot"></div>';
            }
            return dots;
        }

        // 创建条子竹节
        function createBamboo(count) {
            let bamboo = '';
            if (count === 1) {
                bamboo = '<div class="bamboo-stick"></div>';
            } else if (count === 2) {
